title: Check how far each child repo is from claude-settings main
why: Child repos drift from the shared rules, and nobody has measured how far.
note: Check of the child repos against claude-settings main, then a fix lane per repo (coordinator, Oct 29; tag cs-step:child-repo-gap). Placed ahead of c198 (triage 12, Oct 29): it was already running and clashes with no file. At 14:55 CDT: item 75 a, merge home#391, degen#303 and mailaudit#164 on green; item 76 a, home ships the ste-lint CI step alone, no prose cleanup; item 72 b, a separate arbiter role holds q_max's ruling voice and the batch runner takes the batch checks (the role goes into the session tiers, a records lane). Decided with no question, past rulings answer them: project-ops tiers in each repo (item 2 a); each repo's merge grant passes to its batch runner; lane sessions run per item 50 b; q_max's "first version that fixes it" line goes (t18, a repo that differs from a shared format changes to match); degen D10 follows git-integration-branch-merge.
